name: Steel and glass awning
parts: welded steel perimeter frame in box tube with mitred corners
two T-bar purlins dividing three laminated glass panes
three drilled triangular gusset plates under the frame
wall plate with a double row of hex bolts

style: Contemporary steel and glass awning, anthracite powder-coated frame, green laminated glass, gusset plates with lightening holes, chipped coating and rust at welds and bolts
